title: Add route and fallback explanations to output evidence
summary: Add concise route, size guard, and remux fallback explanation evidence to published sidecars and pending publish manifests, and include the concrete remux fallback block reason in oversized-encode failure output.
reason: The operator needs output artifacts to explain why automatic size or bitrate threshold encodes publish, fallback-remux, or fail so future oversized encode outcomes can be diagnosed without reconstructing the decision from route traces and logs.
behavior_before: Output sidecars and pending manifests contained raw route_plan and size_policy metadata, but not a compact operator-facing explanation. Oversized-encode failure markers used a generic 'remux fallback unavailable or blocked' reason without the codec/policy gate that blocked fallback.
behavior_after: Output sidecars and pending manifests include a route_explanation block summarizing the initial route, size guard result, fallback-remux eligibility, and codec-gate outcome. Oversized-encode failure markers and logs include the specific remux fallback block reason and structured fallback rejection details.
tests_added: Library-profile routing source assertions that oversized-encode failure output includes the concrete remux fallback rejection reason.
manual_validation: 2026-06-19: PowerShell parser checks over profile_selection.ps1, failure_state.ps1, pending_park_transaction.ps1, encode.ps1, remux.ps1, Invoke-LibraryProfileRoutingChecks.ps1, and Invoke-RouteExplanationEvidenceChecks.ps1 - passed.
2026-06-19: temporary failure marker smoke verified remux_fallback_rejection and nested route_explanation survive Write-SourceFailureState JSON output - passed.

2026-06-19: ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-MediaRouteSelectionChecks.ps1 was attempted but stopped before the new route-explanation coverage path on an existing unknown-height routing expectation: unknown-height movie expected encode over 22 Mbps but current route logic returned remux using the movie 35 Mbps cap.
rollback_plan: Revert the route explanation helper, pending manifest field addition, failure-context plumbing, fallback rejection reason additions, and associated tests. Existing output artifacts with route_explanation are additive JSON evidence and can be ignored by older readers.
notes: This is intended as an evidence-only change. It must not alter route selection, encode/remux policy, publish safety, pending-publish parking, or source mutation behavior.
